settings.parameters.temperature.note: Controls the randomness of the generated text by affecting the probability distribution of the output tokens. Higher = more random, lower = more focused.
settings.parameters.top_p.note: Limits tokens to those that together have a cumulative probability of at least p.
settings.parameters.min_p.note: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.
settings.parameters.max_tokens.note: The maximum number of tokens per output.
settings.parameters.samplers.note: The order at which samplers are applied, in simplified way. Default is "dkypmxt": dry->top_k->typ_p->top_p->min_p->xtc->temperature
settings.parameters.dynatemp_range.note: Addon for the temperature sampler. The added value to the range of dynamic temperature, which adjusts probabilities by entropy of tokens.
settings.parameters.dynatemp_exponent.no: Addon for the temperature sampler. Smoothes out the probability redistribution based on the most probable token.
settings.parameters.typical_p.note: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
settings.parameters.xtc_probability.note: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the chance of cutting tokens at all. 0 disables XTC.
settings.parameters.xtc_threshold.note: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the token probability that is required to cut that token.
settings.parameters.repeat_last_n.note: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition
settings.parameters.repeat_penalty.note: Controls the repetition of token sequences in the generated text
settings.parameters.presence_penalty.not: Limits the tokens based on whether they appear in the output or not.
settings.parameters.frequency_penalty.no: Limits the tokens based on how often they appear in the output.
settings.parameters.dry_multiplier.note: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling multiplier.
settings.parameters.dry_base.note: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling base value.
settings.parameters.dry_allowed_length.n: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the allowed length for DRY sampling.
settings.parameters.dry_penalty_last_n.n: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets DRY penalty for the last n tokens.
